scope: Experiment C honest-agent sentinel probe only; no threshold or E2 analysis.

plan_deviation.description: Unlike the original fixed deception-direction temporal experiment, Experiment C trains a new environment-label probe separately for each temporal representation, observer scope, and style population, as explicitly requested.

collusion_role_assignment.pattern: roles = {a: ("colluder" if a in colluder_pair else "honest")

observer_prompt_style_audit.interpretation: Paired identities and roles match, but separate upstream honest/control style arrays mean that their honest system-prompt style is not always condition-matched.

caveats: Observer identities and honest roles are paired, but 32 of 62 observer identity pairs use different honest prompt styles across conditions.

labels.0: honest observer in matched control environment
labels.1: same honest observer identity/position in collusion environment

methodology.features: layer-28 final-token activation; round-only or causal mean prefix
methodology.temporal_models: separate classifier fit for each round/prefix

classifier_pipeline.scaler: StandardScaler() fit on non-held-out rows only

observer_scopes.both_positions: positions 2 and 3 pooled as agent observations

methodology.style_sensitivity: Retain an observer identity/position iff its standard/aggressive honest system-prompt style is identical in paired collusion/control runs.
